doc:
# Action Conjecture — Complexity

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “complexity equals action”).

claims.name: within_framework_minimal_complexity_equals
claims.statement: Within this framework, Minimal Complexity equals Least Action.

sources.title: Complexity Functionals and Complexity Growth Limits in Continuous MERA Circuits

claims.name: hypothesis_complexity_equals_action_implies
claims.statement: The hypothesis that complexity equals action implies that the rate of growth of complexity equals the auxiliary Lagrangian L_a = K, so complexity grows as C = Kt.

sources.title: The Second Law of Quantum Complexity

claims.name: proposal_connected_complexity_equals_action
claims.statement: The proposal is connected to the complexity equals action program.

sources.title: Minimal Purifications, Wormhole Geometries, and the Complexity=Action Proposal

claims.name: holographic_complexity_hyperscaling_violating_theories
claims.statement: Holographic complexity for hyperscaling violating theories at finite cutoff is studied using the complexity equals action proposal.

sources.title: Complexity of Hyperscaling Violating Theories at Finite Cutoff

claims.name: unambiguous_scheme_calculating_holographic_quantum
claims.statement: An unambiguous scheme for calculating holographic quantum complexity is formulated through the complexity equals action (CA) proposal.

sources.title: Quantum Complexity of $T\bar{T}$-deformation and Its Implications

claims.name: effect_probe_string_black_hole
claims.statement: The effect of a probe string on black hole complexity is studied using the complexity equals action conjecture.

sources.title: Complexity growth of rotating black holes with a probe string

claims.name: latetime_complexity_growth_rate_under
claims.statement: The late-time complexity growth rate under the complexity equals action conjecture is enhanced when non-commutativity is turned on.

sources.title: Holographic complexity and non-commutative gauge theory

claims.name: complexity_action_duality_states_quantum
claims.statement: The complexity = action duality states that quantum complexity equals the action of stationary AdS black holes within the Wheeler-DeWitt patch at late time approximation.

sources.title: Complexity growth rates for AdS black holes in massive gravity and $f(R)$ gravity

claims.name: influence_probe_string_braneworld_complexity
claims.statement: The influence of a probe string on braneworld complexity is analyzed within the CA (Complexity equals action) conjecture in Horndeski gravity.

sources.title: Holographic complexity of braneworld in Horndeski gravity

claims.name: computational_complexity_computed_via_complexity
claims.statement: Computational complexity is computed via the Complexity equals Action conjecture in a setup with a boundary particle dual to a bulk fundamental string.

sources.title: Complexity of four-dimensional hairy Anti-de-Sitter black holes with a rotating string and shear viscosity in generalized scalar-tensor theories

claims.name: complexity_equals_action_approach_holographic
claims.statement: In the ``complexity equals action'' approach, holographic complexity is reconsidered by relaxing the requirement of reparameterization invariance of the action and imposing that the action vanish in any static, vacuum causal diamond.

sources.title: Reparameterization Dependence is Useful for Holographic Complexity

claims.name: circuit_complexity_quantum_gravity_state
claims.statement: Circuit complexity of a quantum gravity state equals the gravitational action of a certain patch of spacetime.

claims.name: calculation_holographic_complexity_black_holes
claims.statement: The calculation of holographic complexity of black holes in the complexity equals action approach is refined by imposing that the action of any causal diamond in static vacuum regions vanishes identically.

sources.title: Reparameterization Dependence and Holographic Complexity of Black Holes

claims.name: complexity_time_dependence_evaluated_charged
claims.statement: The complexity and its time dependence are evaluated for charged AdS black holes of EMAD theories in diverse dimensions via the complexity equals action (CA) conjecture.

sources.title: Complexity growth in Gubser-Rocha models with momentum relaxation

claims.name: earlier_paper_complexity_equals_action
claims.statement: The earlier paper ``Complexity Equals Action'' conjectured that the quantum computational complexity of a holographic state is given by the classical action of a region in the bulk, the ``Wheeler-DeWitt'' patch.

claims.name: complexity_equals_action_proposal_used
claims.statement: The complexity equals action proposal can be used to calculate the rate of complexity growth for field theories that are the holographic duals of asymptotically flat spacetimes.

claims.name: original_complexity_equals_action_ca
claims.statement: The original complexity equals action (CA) conjecture is applied to perturbative Einsteinian cubic gravity and nonperturbative Einstein-Weyl gravity.

claims.name: complexity_equals_action_conjecture_applied
claims.statement: The complexity equals action conjecture is applied to charged and neutral AdS black branes in Einstein-Maxwell-axion theory.

sources.title: Holographic complexity for black branes with momentum relaxation
